Vesti costume.
Obtained from an Event Pass.

lines.text: Err... C-can you teach me how to make friends?
What am I good at? Hmm... Killing?
I don't care if you're my Commander. I won't let you make fun of me and call me a crybaby!
C-Commander, do you remember what was written down in my diary?
I've been laughing non-stop recently... What is happening to me?
C-can you take me to watch a movie again?
Co... Commander... Commander?
I can't believe this, the Commander deserted me again!
Did you know that there are all sorts of scary rumors about the armory?
Dear diary, today I spoke to the Commander longer than ever before. Two whole sentences! Not bad, huh?
Every day, I imagine all the ways I'd love to get back at my tormentors... It's the only thing that gives me inner peace.
No, please don't treat me like this... I don't know what I'll end up doing.
Th-thank you for standing up for me!
I... seem to be getting stronger.
Will I be able to kill people more easily from now on?
Is... Is it for me? Really?
... I feel happy.
Do friends often give each other things like this?
So... does that mean we've become closer friends? Actually... I wish we were closer than this.
What to do... I miss the Commander even when we see each other all the time.
Is... is this feeling... love?
J-just leave it to me!
I'm listening.
I-I'm on the move.
Time to fight.
I'll wipe you all out.
My fantasies have finally become reality.
This won't take long.
Th-there aren't enough bullets.
... Will this do?
Come on!
I'm... I'm ready.
D-don't come any closer, or... I'll have to kill you all.
So... all I have to do is kill them all?
Enemy down.
Another enemy down.
How am I doing?
Eeep!
Aah!
Argh.
I-I'm sorry...
A-are you proud of me?
Wh-when are we going on an adventure?

Why don't I consider learning other spells?
There's no point in mastering anything other than explosive magic.
A magic wand? I... I've got one right here.
Explosions are what I dream about!

Isn't my staff cute? I call her Kitty.
W-would the Armored Knight like to be friends with her?
I-I'm confident that when it comes to explosions, no one can beat me!
Where did everyone go? Weren't we in the same party?

I wanted to make this explode too, but is now the time?
The extradimensional truth which transcends all, appears here as a distortion...
So... can I blow up that building?
Where do I a-accept quests from?

I-I cast explosive magic every morning.
I find it really soothing.
I-I'm Vesti, b-but they call me the Blue-Eyed Little Devil.
Now I can probably take on higher-level quests.
I'll work even harder to show you the best explosion possible.
Now I'll be able to blow things up with even more panache!
I never thought there'd be something else as nice as blowing stuff up.
Heh, hehe.
Since you gave me this, does that mean we're friends? Or... are we more than that? Er... What exactly are we?
I-it feels like my heart's going to explode...
My feelings for you keep growing, Armored Knight.
From here on out, this is my only party.
Are you joining my party?
A-awaiting your order.
T-this way?
Commencing the hunt.
Can I... blow everything up?
I'll blow these monsters away!
I've been waiting for this moment!
Ammunition... No, I'm out of mana.
Be my bullet sponge for a moment, please.
Can you buy me some time?
I-I'll cast a spell now.
Final Flame Explosion!
Explosions are an art... Hehe...!
Heh, hehe.
What an explosion!
What should I blow up next?
Gah!
Yikes...!
Ugh.
I'm sorry... I'll have to leave the rest to you.
Wow, what a wonderful explosion that was today. I'd give it a perfect 10/10, wouldn't you?
